about: Knowledge file for "Fill from document" on the fact find. It lists, section by section, the fields a client's form or an adviser's notes can fill: the labels people write for each field and how its answer is read. What is read from an uploaded document is matched against this file and turned into one JSON object per fact-find section. Edit this file to teach it a new label, option or field; no code change is needed. The document itself is read in the browser and never uploaded.

howToEdit.sections[].id: The fact-find page the fields belong to (personal-details, dependants, employment…).
howToEdit.sections[].default: true on the one section that answers with no heading above them belong to.
howToEdit.sections[].headings: Words that mark this section's heading on a document ("Dependent Details", "Employment"). Lower case; a word may be a stem ("employ").
howToEdit.fields[].key: The form's field name (camelCase), used as the key in the extracted JSON.
howToEdit.fields[].label: The field as the CRM shows it.
howToEdit.fields[].aliases: Other labels documents use for it ("dob", "surname"). Lower case, no punctuation.
howToEdit.fields[].kind: How the answer is read: text | name | fullName | date | choice | yesNo | number | money | email | phone | niNumber.
howToEdit.fields[].choices: For kind 'choice': the allowed values, each with the words people write for it.
howToEdit.fields[].choicesFrom: For kind 'choice': a list loaded by the CRM instead (countries, nationalities). choiceAliases adds words for its values.
howToEdit.fields[].allowOther: For kind 'choice': keep an answer that matches no choice, for the adviser to check.
howToEdit.fields[].minAge: For a date of birth: younger than this is marked unsure (likely someone else's date).
howToEdit.fields[].vocabulary: Words often written as the answer ("full time", "accountant"). Not a list of allowed values: they only help the text reader make out messy handwriting.
howToEdit.fields[].required: true: must be filled before the section can be saved (while onlyIf holds).
howToEdit.fields[].onlyIf: The field applies only when another field of the section is { equals } a value, or is { filled }. Otherwise it is hidden, not required and saved as empty.
howToEdit.sections[].when: 'mortgage' or 'protection': the section exists only on that kind of case.
howToEdit.sections[].save.api: How the section is saved: personal-details | dependant | employment-income | expenditure (each saved by its own rules), or record: GET then PUT /fact-finds/clients/{client}/{endpoint}, keeping what is stored and replacing these fields.
howToEdit.sections[].save.pages: The fact-find pages (sidebar) that show this section's data; marked when values read from a document are not saved yet.
howToEdit.sections[].save.omitEmpty: record: unanswered fields are left out of the payload (as the page does).
howToEdit.sections[].save.emptyAsZero: record: an empty amount is saved as 0 (as the page does).
howToEdit.sections[].save.dropSaved: record: stored keys never sent back.
howToEdit.otherHeadings: Headings for parts of the fact find with no fields here yet (mortgage, protection, existing property, financial overview). Answers under them are listed, never filled.
